request: a bento box-inspired collapsible UI menu component for a fictional coffee company site
thesis: A menu that opens like a lacquered bento lid: a trigger collapses into a compact bar and unfolds into an asymmetric grid of compartments, each a different size, each holding one destination, like a lunch box packed by hand.
job: see the closed menu bar/trigger and know it opens
open it by click, tap, Enter or Space
scan the compartments and spot the featured one
hover/focus a compartment and see it respond
pick a destination (it marks as current, a status line says so)
use a compartment's own control (quantity, roast toggle, newsletter email)
collapse it by trigger, Escape, outside click or after picking
do all of it by keyboard, on a phone, with reduced motion

principles: disclosure pattern: button controls a region
state must be visible: open, current, hover, focus
one clear primary path, others secondary
tricks: close on Escape and return focus to trigger
tests: open twice in a row, state still right

principles: compartments differ in size but share gutters and radius
one dominant tile, several quiet ones
warm coffee palette with one sharp accent
tricks: grid-template-areas with spans for the bento rhythm
inner tile shadow like a tray inset
tests: squint: is there one featured tile?

principles: stagger tiles so the box 'packs' itself
tricks: reverse stagger on close is faster
hidden tiles get inert/visibility hidden when closed
tests: tab order while closed skips tiles

principles: one state object, render from it

parts: trigger bar with brand mark and label

kinds.name: dropdown bento panel from a nav bar
kinds.what: classic: bar with trigger, grid unfolds beneath

descriptions: fictional roaster, e.g. Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters, small-batch

behaviors: open: panel height grows, tiles rise in with stagger 30 to 60ms
picking a tile sets current, updates status line, collapses menu
roast toggle cycles light/medium/dark and recolors its tile
bag quantity +/- updates cart count in trigger
email field validates on submit and says so

anti_keywords.instead: spans and a clear featured tile

anti_keywords.not: purple gradient or stock SaaS look

checks: closed: aria-expanded=false and tiles unreachable by Tab
Escape closes and focus returns to trigger
clicking a tile marks it current and status text changes
built: dropdown bento panel from a nav bar
